sections.what: The paperdoll in the Equipment tab currently uses text labels only. Add SVG icon art from game-icons.net (CC0/CC BY 3.0) to make each slot visually distinctive with fantasy/RPG-themed icons.
sections.why: Paperdoll has 13 slots in CSS grid human silhouette, each showing a text label ("Head", "Neck", "Torso", etc.) and the equipped item name. No visual icons.
sections.how: 1. Create `static/icons/` directory 2. Save each SVG file with `fill="currentColor"` 3. Update inspector.js paperdoll rendering to reference SVGs inline or via `` tags 4. CSS: slot icon color from `var(--text-dim)` when empty, `var(--accent)` when filled
